item.title: Self-Hosted Disk Forensics: Autopsy vs The Sleuth Kit vs Guymager (2026)
item.description: Disk forensics is the practice of recovering, analyzing, and preserving digital evidence from storage media. Whether investigating a security incident, recovering deleted files, or maintaining chain of custody for legal proceedings, having the right self-hosted forensics toolkit is essential.
